intent_contract.text: 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create an independently authored, random-feeling but photographically plausible Clockpunk scene whose defining mechanics can later be judged directly in rendered pixels. The supplied portrait is used only as a guide to broad visible appearance traits for an unmistakably adult subject; biometric identity is outside the evaluation.

Create a cinematic environmental photograph of a spring-wound Clockpunk eclipse rehearsal inside a midnight civic time tower. An unmistakably adult woman, whose broad appearance cues are guided only by the supplied portrait, has long near-black wavy hair, warm brown eyes, softly arched brows, an oval face, and natural rose lips. Wearing a charcoal horologist’s coat threaded with fine watch chains, she turns an oversized brass winding key inside a glass-cased astronomical clock. The key action visibly releases a palm-sized enamel mechanical bird from an opened escapement cage as a coiled mainspring unspools, interlocking brass gears advance concentric numbered dials, and a moon-phase disk clicks into eclipse. Surround her with suspended pocket watches, calibration tools, and a wall-sized gear train, all built as tactile practical machinery. Prioritize readable hand-to-key contact, functional spring-and-escapement causality, richly aged brass, enamel, glass, and a believable photographed human presence.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
